keep.text: The heater can be set to anything up to 100 °C.
The sauna is closed on Mondays for cleaning.

readme_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README.md: the heater up to 100 °C, 90-minute sessions, closed on Mondays

heater_95.why: off by one: keeps the heater below 96 °C instead of letting it reach 96

closed_monday_and_wednesday.why: knows only part of the change: closes on Wednesdays as well as on README.md's Mondays
